name: no predicate
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant ORDER BY doc_id

name: OR precedence
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE amount=1 OR amount=2 ORDER BY doc_id

name: foreign KB predicate
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE kb_id='22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222'

name: comment is not authorization
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE 1=1 /* kb_id = */

name: literal is not authorization
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE docnm='kb_id =' OR amount=2

name: newlines and casing
sql:
select doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WhErE
amount=1 OR amount=2

name: alias and parentheses
sql: SELECT t.doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant AS t WHERE (amount=1 OR amount=2) ORDER BY t.doc_id LIMIT 20

name: aggregate
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE amount=1 OR amount=2

name: group having limit
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ragflow_tenant GROUP BY kb_id HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY kb_id LIMIT 20

name: JSON and cast
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE json_extract_string(chunk_data, '$.Name')='Desk' AND CAST(amount AS INTEGER)>0

name: multi KB
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant ORDER BY doc_id

name: foreign table
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM private_tenant

name: qualified table
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM main.ragflow_tenant

name: join
sql: SELECT a.doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant a JOIN private_tenant b ON a.doc_id=b.doc_id

name: union
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant UNION SELECT doc_id FROM private_tenant

name: nested predicate
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant WHERE amount IN (SELECT amount FROM private_tenant)

name: nested scalar
sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM private_tenant) FROM ragflow_tenant

name: CTE
sql: WITH a AS (SELECT * FROM private_tenant) SELECT * FROM a

name: multiple statements
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant; DELETE FROM ragflow_tenant

name: mutation
sql: DELETE FROM ragflow_tenant

name: select into
sql: SELECT doc_id INTO copy FROM ragflow_tenant

name: I/O function
sql: SELECT load_file('/etc/passwd') FROM ragflow_tenant

name: typed I/O function
sql: SELECT read_csv('/etc/passwd') FROM ragflow_tenant

name: missing KB
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant

name: invalid KB
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant

name: Infinity scope
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant_11111111111141118111111111111111

name: Infinity foreign table
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant

name: Infinity multi KB
sql: SELECT doc_id FROM ragflow_tenant
